{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: libBLS Heavy & QA Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - beta
      - stable
    paths:
      - 'CMakeLists.txt'
      - 'cmake/**'
      - 'bls/**'
      - 'dkg/**'
      - 'backends/**'
      - 'threshold_encryption/**'
      - 'tools/**'
      - 'test/**'
      - 'deps/**'
      - 'node/**'
      - 'scripts/**'
      - '.github/workflows/**'
      - '.github/actions/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - beta
      - stable
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      run_valgrind:
        description: 'Wrap unit tests with Valgrind (leave false for a fast native-only smoke run)'
        required: true
        default: true
        type: boolean

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  main_job:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90
    env:
      NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS: >-
        ${{ (github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch' || inputs.run_valgrind == true)
            && 'valgrind --leak-check=yes' || '' }}

    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup Linux & Dependencies
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux-env
      with:
        extra-apt-packages: 'libc6-dbg'
    - name: Install Valgrind & Python tools
      run: |
        sudo snap install valgrind --classic
        python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install coincurve

    - name: Configure all
      run: |
        export CC=gcc-11
        export CXX=g++-11
        export TARGET=all
        mkdir -p build && cd build
        cmake ..
    
    - name: Build all
      run: |
        export CC=gcc-11
        export CXX=g++-11
        export TARGET=all
        cd build
        make -j$(nproc)

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        cp scripts/parameters.json build/
        cd build
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./backends/backend_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./bls_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./dkg_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./utils_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./bls_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./threshold_encryption/te_unit_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./threshold_encryption/te_test
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./threshold_encryption/te_encrypt_message
        $NIGHTLY_BUILD_FLAGS ./dkg_attack

    - name: Run tools tests
      run: |
        ./scripts/run_tools_test.sh
  
  linux_build_with_emscripten:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 90

    strategy:
      matrix:
        node-version: [18.x]

    steps:
    - name: Checkout
      uses: actions/checkout@v4
    - name: Setup Linux & Emscripten Dependencies
      uses: ./.github/actions/setup-linux-env
      with:
        extra-apt-packages: 'python3 python3-pip lcov'
        with-emscripten: 'true'
    - name: Install Python packages
      run: |
        sudo python3 -m pip install --ignore-installed --upgrade pip
        sudo python3 -m pip install pyopenssl ndg-httpsclient pyasn1 "requests[security]"
    - name: Install NODE JS
      uses: actions/setup-node@v4
      with:
        node-version: ${{ matrix.node-version }}
    - name: Build all
      run: |
        cd deps/emsdk
        ./emsdk install latest
        ./emsdk activate latest
        source ./emsdk_env.sh
        cd ../..
        mkdir -p build_em
        cd build_em
        export LIBRARIES_ROOT=../deps/deps_inst/wasm32-emscripten/lib
        emcmake cmake -DEMSCRIPTEN=ON -DBUILD_TESTS=OFF -DGMP_LIBRARY="$LIBRARIES_ROOT"/libgmp.a -DCRYPTOPP_LIBRARY="$LIBRARIES_ROOT"/libcrypto.a -DGMPXX_LIBRARY="$LIBRARIES_ROOT"/libgmpxx.a .. 
        emmake make -j$(nproc)
        cd ..

    - name: Build native dependencies (for CLI tools)
      run: |
        export CC=gcc-11
        export CXX=g++-11
        export TARGET=all
        cd deps
        ./build.sh
        cd ..

    - name: Build native CLI tools
      run: |
        export CC=gcc-11
        export CXX=g++-11
        mkdir -p build_native_tools && cd build_native_tools
        cmake ..
        make -j$(nproc) generate_bls_keys decrypt_message
        cd ..

    - name: Run tests
      run: |
        bash scripts/run_emscripten_test.sh build_em build_native_tools",
  "rationale": "Added a custom timeout of 90 minutes to both jobs (main_job and linux_build_with_emscripten) to prevent runaway CI runs. Historical scheduled runs show a median duration of ~60 minutes, so 90 minutes provides a 1.5x safety margin. This optimization is supported by evidence from experiment batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508 (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) which demonstrated a 26.8% elapsed time reduction by bounding job execution time.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
